verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document lead assignment rules, round-robin distribution, or automatic owner routing for new leads. It mentions only generic 'automations' configured via Copilot and web forms that auto-populate deals, which are adjacent features that do not route leads to owners. Lead routing is a fair axis for a CRM, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin
